''Patch change 20 Feb, 2012: Kanras: Updated Avatar to give 100 AGI.''

nodes.label: Malo
nodes.description:
Decreases your target's resistance to cold, fire, magic, and poison.

Note: Casting this spell is irresistible which will land 100% of the time. This explains it's extremely high price tag and the necessity against high target monsters and end game bosses.

nodes.label: Focus of Spirit
nodes.description:
Focuses your target's spiritual energy, granting increased hit points, strength, and dexterity for 1 hour(s) 40.0 mins.
This spell has an unusual stacking mechanic. If a character has Focus, it will block the addition of Maniacal Strength, Mortal Deftness, and Voice of the Berserker spells. ''However'' if the character already has those buffs prior, the addition of Focus on top of those will not overwrite them, rather it will stack and both will apply to the character's statistics. Therefore, if a melee character would like all three buffs, they should click off any pre-existing Focus, then ask the Shaman for them.
Focus of Spirit will always overwrite other Talisman spells however. It also seems to overwrite lower level spells such as Dexterity.

Does not stack with Shield of the Magi and other INT caster HP buffs. Does not stack with Bedlam and other enchanter mat-free runes in that line. Does stack with Resurrection Effects.

nodes.label: Eastern Wastes
nodes.lore: The Eastern Wastes are a vast area of frozen ground covering much of the northeastern continent of Velious. There are many groups here, the Coldain, the Frost Giants, and the orcs of Ry'Gorr Keep, who have outposts or homes here.

nodes.label: Kael Drakkal
nodes.lore: Kael Drakkel (Sometimes Kael Drakkal) is the home city of the giants of Velious - the Kromzek and the Kromrif. The city was founded by giant refugees fleeing the wrath of the other gods after Rallos Zek's invasion of the Plane of Earth.

nodes.label: Skyshrine
nodes.lore: A large tower located in the Wakening Lands. Skyshrine is the home of Lord Yelinak, the Dragon who controls the zone, keeping the Giants from getting to the Western Wastes.

nodes.label: Iceclad Ocean
nodes.lore: The Iceclad Ocean consists of two parts, the open ocean between it and the other continents of Norrath, and Icy Fingers, a series of small fragmented islands that lead to the continent of Velious itself.

nodes.label: Eye of Zomm
nodes.description:
Conjures a magical eye that allows you to scout dangerous areas.
While under the effect of this spell, a new low level NPC is spawned that looks like a spinning eye. After a short delay, the camera switches to follow this eye and the caster can control it with most normal movement commands. The eye has the same faction as the player, and if the player is not under Feign Death, they will gain any aggro which the eye has. Thus, it is useful as a long-range pulling method.
Like other NPCs, players can attack the eye and cannot buff it ''(not sure if it's a case-by-case basis but I regularly cast Bedlam on my eyes without issue to get extra hits in)''. It's possible to summon the eye and hit it with weapons such as the Worker Sledgemallet just to gain a proc effect. It has good swimming speed but cannot jump and may have difficulty getting out of the water.

Can not be cast in Plane of Sky or Kedge Keep.

nodes.label: Tishan's Relocation
nodes.description:
Opens an arcane portal that teleports your entire group to the Skyfire Mountains. This spell no longer has a Kunark dungeon requirement; it can currently be cast from anywhere in the world.

'''Warning: The port in location for this spell is very dangerous.''' If you port in while visible, you will most likely die when alone or porting another. There are swarms of dispelling mobs at the zone in area. However, while invis, this port in location is nearly 100% safe. No mobs see invis and the only threat is the possibility of it breaking early. You can enter the zone invisibly by getting a friendly person to invis prime you. To perform this, join a group, and have that person begin to invis you. Before their cast finishes, begin your cast of Tishan's Relocation. Once their invis hits you, disband or have them disband before you finish the cast. You will port over to skyfire while remaining invis, as finishing casts does not break invisibility. With a primed invis, the port in at skyfire is much safer, and a very useful tool to Wizards.

nodes.label: Balanced
nodes.description: All incoming damage is reduced by 10% and your chance to hit is increased by 10%. Endurance regen excluding out of combat bonus regen is doubled. There is no endurance cost to upkeep this stance.

nodes.label: Berserker
nodes.description: While this stance is active, attack speed and combat skill recharge rate is doubled and your chance to hit and combat skill damage is increased by 25%. Every point of damage dealt consumes half that amount in endurance, with a reduction based on your strategy skill. You also take 8.3% of outgoing damage to yourself. Bonus damage from critical hits and similar effects do not cost endurance.

nodes.label: Channeler
nodes.description: All incoming damage is reduced by 40% and your chance to successfully channel is increased. Half of the mitigated damage is charged to both mana and endurance, with a reduction based on your strategy skill.

nodes.label: Defensive
nodes.description: All incoming melee damage is reduced by 50% and incoming magical damage is reduced by 20%. Every point of damage reduced consumes an equal amount of endurance, with a reduction based on your strategy skill.

nodes.label: Evasive
nodes.description: You have a 95% chance to evade all incoming attacks. Every point of damage evaded consumes 2 endurance, with a reduction based on your strategy skill. Evasion will fail if you have insufficient endurance, or while playing dead.

nodes.label: Mage Hunter
nodes.description: All incoming spell damage is reduced by 50% and incoming physical damage is reduced by 20%. Every point of damage reduced consumes an equal amount of endurance, with a reduction based on your strategy skill.

nodes.label: Offensive
nodes.description: Outgoing melee damage is increased by 100% and your chance to hit is increased by 25%. Every point of bonus damage dealt consumes an equal amount of endurance, with a reduction based on your strategy skill. When below 25% endurance, the chance to hit bonus is reduced based on the remaining percent of endurance. Bonus damage from critical hits and similar effects do not cost endurance.

nodes.label: Ranged
nodes.description: Your range attack has no minimum distance, gains a 25% accuracy bonus, and can double and triple attack. Every point of damage consumes endurance, with a reduction based on your strategy skill.

nodes.label: Striker
nodes.description: Outgoing weapon skill abilities deal 3x damage and non-weapon skill abilities deal 5x damage, and your chance to hit is increased by 25%. Every point of damage dealt consumes an equal amount of endurance, with a reduction based on your strategy skill. When below 25% endurance, the chance to hit bonus is reduced based on the remaining percent of endurance. Bonus damage from critical hits and similar effects do not cost endurance.

nodes.label: Arcane Mastery

nodes.label: Divine
nodes.description: Spending mana will heal the group member with the lowest hp percentage by that amount. For every additional wisdom class, this will repeat with a heal for 33% of the mana spent.

nodes.label: Empower

nodes.label: Inversion

nodes.label: Inviolable

nodes.label: Recovery

nodes.description: Snare. Cut's circulation to your target's legs, slowing their movement speed for up to 0:03:00, effect duration 48 seconds.

nodes.label: Concussive Strike
nodes.description: Causes your opponent to twitch violently, interrupting spell casting 75% of the time, pushback 2.

nodes.label: Befuddling Strike
nodes.description: Causes your opponent to clutch their head, draining their mana by 110.

nodes.label: Grounding Strike
nodes.description: Blocks the nerves to your opponent's legs, rooting them for up to 0:01:00.

nodes.label: Stunning Strike
nodes.description: Injects a paralytic agent, stunning your opponent. This effect works on creatures up to level 50. Pushback 1.

nodes.label: Banishing Poison
nodes.description: Dispel. Only one utility poison can be active at a time.

nodes.label: Lay Hands
nodes.description: An instant heal equal to roughly 32x the paladin's level to a single target (1,728 HP at level 60).

nodes.label: Harm Touch
nodes.description: Deals a large amount of damage to a single target, scaling from 11 at level 1 to 1,001 at level 60.

nodes.label: Backstab
nodes.description: Massive damage with a piercing weapon in the main hand, if the target's back (or side, within 180°) is exposed; otherwise lands as a normal hit. Damage scales with skill and the equipped dagger.

nodes.label: Mend
nodes.description: Heals the user for 25% of their total health. Below 100 skill, a failed attempt can damage instead of heal.

nodes.label: Bash
nodes.description: Uses an equipped shield to bash the current target for a chance to stun; the shield's AC affects damage. Shares a cooldown with Slam.

nodes.label: Kick
nodes.description: A leg strike dealing direct damage. Shares a cooldown with Bash, Slam, and the Monk kick-family specials (Round Kick, Tiger Claw, Eagle Strike, Dragon Punch/Tail Rake).

nodes.label: Taunt
nodes.description: A small chance to move the user to the top of the target's aggro list. Has no effect on a target already attacking the user.

nodes.label: Hide
nodes.description: Grants an Invisibility-like effect as long as the user doesn't move; higher skill increases success chance. (Also granted to Dark Elves/Wood Elves/Halflings by race, capped at 50 — not shown here since the Class Browser is organized by class.)

nodes.label: Sneak
nodes.description: Moves silently and appears Indifferent to any NPC not facing the user. (Also granted to Halflings by race, capped at 50 — not shown here since the Class Browser is organized by class.)

nodes.label: Disarm
nodes.description: Dislodges the target's wielded weapon, forcing it to fight hand-to-hand. Against NPCs the weapon becomes lootable rather than dropping to the ground.

nodes.label: Pick Lock
nodes.description: Unlocks doors that normally require a key, for as long as the door stays open. Always succeeds if skill meets the door's minimum, always fails (no skill-up chance) if it doesn't.

nodes.label: Pick Pocket
nodes.description: Attempts to steal an item or coin from a humanoid enemy. Cannot be used while auto-attacking, and can't target magic or wielded items.

nodes.label: Disarm Traps
nodes.description: Disables environmental traps so a group can pass safely.

nodes.label: Round Kick
nodes.description: A Monk special attack, superseded by Tiger Claw at level 10.

nodes.label: Tiger Claw
nodes.description: A Monk special attack replacing Round Kick, superseded by Eagle Strike at level 20.

nodes.label: Eagle Strike
nodes.description: A Monk special attack replacing Tiger Claw, superseded by Dragon Punch/Tail Rake at level 25. Max damage at level 20 is 16.

nodes.label: Dragon Punch
nodes.description: A Monk special attack replacing Eagle Strike, for Human Monks (Iksar Monks get Tail Rake instead). Superseded by Flying Kick at level 30.

nodes.label: Tail Rake
nodes.description: A Monk special attack replacing Eagle Strike, for Iksar Monks (Human Monks get Dragon Punch instead). Superseded by Flying Kick at level 30.

nodes.label: Katta's Song of Sword Dancing line
Stonebrunt Mountains
nodes.lore: The Stonebrunt Mountains is a very spiritual place. It is the home of the Kejekan people, who rule over the land atop Mount Klaw, within the small fortress of Kejek.

legend.label: Highland Kobold Camps
Town of Kejek, with Merchants selling Weapon Molds, Ore, Clay, Smithing Hammers, Pottery Equipment, and Baking Supplies, and Oven, Kiln, Pottery Wheel, and Forge (1350, 1025)
Kobold Camps (Southeastern camp is empty)
Dock with Kejekan Fishermen
A spirit is located at 470, -39
Entrance to the Warrens is located at -3880, 2967

nodes.label: Forage
nodes.description: Finds food and other useful items from the local environment on a timer. Druid's cap scales with level ((Level×5)+5); also granted to Iksar/Wood Elf by race, fixed at 50 — not shown here since the Class Browser is organized by class.

nodes.label: Tracking
nodes.description: Follows traces of other creatures over distance; higher skill and certain classes track farther (Ranger tracks best, then Druid, then Bard).

nodes.label: Safe Fall
nodes.description: Reduces or prevents damage from long falls.

nodes.label: Sense Traps
nodes.description: Detects traps on objects or in passageways before they trigger.

nodes.label: Breastplate of Ro
nodes.source: Armor of Ro questline reward, combined at a forge from a Mold of Ro + Bar of Ronium

nodes.label: Mold of Ro Bracer
nodes.description: David's share of the Armor of Ro questline, trading proof of Deepwater Knights standing for a mold that becomes the Bracer of Ro.
steps: Reach Amiable faction with the Deepwater Knights
Obtain 2x Deepwater Goblin Nets (from a goblin net master, Lake Rathetear)
Turn it in to David in Rathe Mountains for a Mold of Ro Bracer
Combine the mold with a Bar of Ronium at a non-cultural forge for the finished Bracer of Ro

nodes.label: Mold of Ro Bracer
nodes.source: Reward for turning in 2x Deepwater Goblin Nets to David (Rathe Mountains, Deepwater Knights faction)

nodes.label: Journeyman's Boots
nodes.description: Hasten Bootstrutter, a gnome who never stops wandering Rathe Mountains, trades a permanent movement-speed clicky for a Ring of the Ancients, a borrowed Shadowed Rapier, and a small fortune in gold.
steps: Obtain a Ring of the Ancients
Kill an Ancient Cyclops (found in Ocean of Tears, Southern Desert of Ro, South Karana, or East Karana) for a Shadowed Rapier -- it vanishes 30 minutes after logging off, so don't dawdle turning it in
Gather 3,250 gold pieces (actual gold coin, not platinum)
Track down Hasten Bootstrutter in Rathe Mountains and turn in all three before he wanders off

nodes.label: Journeyman's Boots
nodes.effect: JourneymanBoots (movement speed, Instant cast, outdoor use only)
nodes.source: Journeyman's Boots quest reward (Hasten Bootstrutter, Rathe Mountains)

nodes.label: Research Aid
nodes.description: Mrysila, Northern Karana's resident scholar, trades lightstones for spell-research aids -- a repeatable turn-in, not a one-time quest.
steps: Reach at least Apprehensive faction with Mrysila (Dubious or worse consumes your items without reward)
Turn in a Lightstone (a common willowisp drop) for a Runes and Research tome
Turn in a Greater Lightstone for a Concordance of Research

nodes.label: Concordance of Research
nodes.source: Tradeskill container for spell research; reward for turning in a Greater Lightstone to Mrysila (Research Aid quest)

nodes.label: Paladin Epic Quest
nodes.description: The long road to a Fiery Defender: purify three tainted darksteel pieces across three separate zone-spanning sub-quests, then combine them with a Fiery Avenger for Irak Altil in the Plane of Fear.
steps: Obtain the Tainted Darksteel Breastplate from Thought Destroyer in the Plane of Hate, then purify it via Jark and Nella Stonebraids in Kaladim for a Pure Crystal
Obtain the Tainted Darksteel Sword from the Keeper of the Tombs in The Hole, then purify it by helping a peasant woman and her brother Joshua in West Freeport for a Bucket of Pure Water
Obtain the Tainted Darksteel Shield from Kirak Vil in Nektulos Forest, then purify it through Elia the Pure in Felwithe
Return all three purified pieces to Reklon Gnallen in Erudin's Temple of Quellious for the Mark of Atonement
Complete the separate Fiery Avenger prerequisite quest
Turn in the Mark of Atonement and the Fiery Avenger to Irak Altil in the Plane of Fear

nodes.label: Fiery Defender
nodes.source: Paladin Epic Quest final reward (Irak Altil, Plane of Fear)

nodes.label: Cleric Epic Quest
nodes.description: A three-orb odyssey across Norrath's oceans and volcanoes, ending with the Water Sprinkler of Nem Ankh from the Avatar of Water.
steps: Orb of Frozen Water: kill Lord Bergurgle and trade his crown to Shmendrik Lavawalker, defeat the Spirit of Flame, trade its Damaged Goblin Crown to Natasha Whitewater for an Ornate Sea Shell, give the shell to Omat Vastsea in Timorous Deep for a Coral Statue, present the statue to A Seeker in the Temple of Solusek Ro (it becomes A Plasmatic Priest -- defeat it), kill Lord Gimblox in Solusek's Eye, then return the Plasmatic Priest Robe to Omat

Orb of Clear Water: trade Lord Gimblox's Signet Ring to Natasha for a second Ornate Sea Shell, give it to Naxot Deepwater in Burning Woods to spawn Ixiblat Fer, kill it for a Sceptre, kill Overking Bathezid in Chardok for a Singed Scroll, then trade both to Omat

Orb of Vapor: give a Message to Natasha for a Shimmering Pearl, present it to Zordak Ragefire in Nagafen's Lair (it becomes Zordakalicus Ragefire), kill it and loot its Heart, then trade the heart to Omat
Give all three orbs to Jhassad Oceanson for the Orb of Triumvirate
Present the Orb of Triumvirate to the Avatar of Water

nodes.label: Water Sprinkler of Nem Ankh
nodes.source: Cleric Epic Quest final reward (the Avatar of Water)

nodes.label: Armor of Ro
nodes.description: A Paladin-only armor set. Each piece has its own independent faction-gated turn-in at the Rathe Mountains paladin camp for a Mold of Ro; combine any mold with a hand-crafted Bar of Ronium at a non-cultural forge for the finished piece. There's no need to do all seven.
steps: Reach Amiable faction with Lord Searfire in the Temple of Solusek Ro

Gather the five Bar of Ronium ingredients: 2x Enchanted Platinum Bar, Melatite (from clockworks in Solusek's Eye), Mistmoore Granite (from gargoyles in Mistmoore Castle), Sand of Ro (from sand giants in the Ro zones), and Soil of Underfoot (from Priestess Ghalea in Kaladim)
Combine the ingredients into a Bar of Ronium at a Sol Cauldron
Complete any of the seven Mold of Ro sub-quests at the Rathe Mountains paladin camp
Combine the mold and the Bar of Ronium at a non-cultural forge for the matching finished piece

nodes.label: Mold of Ro Boots
nodes.description: Nicholas's share of the Armor of Ro questline, trading proof of Clerics of Underfoot standing for a mold that becomes the Boots of Ro.
steps: Reach Amiable faction with the Clerics of Underfoot
Obtain Kilij Plans (from Sandgiant Husam, South Ro)
Turn it in to Nicholas in Rathe Mountains for a Mold of Ro Boots
Combine the mold with a Bar of Ronium at a non-cultural forge for the finished Boots of Ro

nodes.label: Mold of Ro Boots
nodes.source: Reward for turning in Kilij Plans to Nicholas (Rathe Mountains, Clerics of Underfoot faction)

nodes.label: Boots of Ro
nodes.source: Armor of Ro questline reward, combined at a forge from a Mold of Ro Boots + Bar of Ronium

nodes.label: Bracer of Ro
nodes.source: Armor of Ro questline reward, combined at a forge from a Mold of Ro Bracer + Bar of Ronium

nodes.label: Mold of Ro Breastplate
nodes.description: Abigail's share of the Armor of Ro questline, trading proof of Clerics of Tunare standing for a mold that becomes the Breastplate of Ro.
steps: Reach Amiable faction with the Clerics of Tunare
Obtain 2x Dark Cauldron (from an ancille cook, Mistmoore Castle)
Turn it in to Abigail in Rathe Mountains for a Mold of Ro Breastplate
Combine the mold with a Bar of Ronium at a non-cultural forge for the finished Breastplate of Ro

nodes.label: Mold of Ro Breastplate
nodes.source: Reward for turning in 2x Dark Cauldron to Abigail (Rathe Mountains, Clerics of Tunare faction)

nodes.label: Mold of Ro Gauntlets
nodes.description: Sentry Joanna's share of the Armor of Ro questline, trading proof of Priests of Marr standing for a mold that becomes the Gauntlets of Ro.
steps: Reach Amiable faction with the Priests of Marr
Obtain A Locket (from Sentry Alechin or a werewolf, Southern Karana -- killing the werewolf form avoids faction damage)
Turn it in to Sentry Joanna in Rathe Mountains for a Mold of Ro Gauntlets
Combine the mold with a Bar of Ronium at a non-cultural forge for the finished Gauntlets of Ro

nodes.label: Mold of Ro Gauntlets
nodes.source: Reward for turning in A Locket to Sentry Joanna (Rathe Mountains, Priests of Marr faction)

nodes.label: Gauntlets of Ro
nodes.source: Armor of Ro questline reward, combined at a forge from a Mold of Ro Gauntlets + Bar of Ronium

nodes.label: Mold of Ro Greaves
nodes.description: Elisabeth's share of the Armor of Ro questline, trading proof of Knights of Truth standing for a mold that becomes the Greaves of Ro.
steps: Reach Amiable faction with the Knights of Truth
Obtain Nightfall Giant's Head (from a nightfall giant, West Commonlands)
Turn it in to Elisabeth in Rathe Mountains for a Mold of Ro Greaves
Combine the mold with a Bar of Ronium at a non-cultural forge for the finished Greaves of Ro

nodes.label: Mold of Ro Greaves
nodes.source: Reward for turning in Nightfall Giant's Head to Elisabeth (Rathe Mountains, Knights of Truth faction)

nodes.label: Greaves of Ro
nodes.source: Armor of Ro questline reward, combined at a forge from a Mold of Ro Greaves + Bar of Ronium

nodes.label: Mold of Ro Helm
nodes.description: Thomas's share of the Armor of Ro questline, trading proof of Knights of Thunder standing for a mold that becomes the Helm of Ro.
steps: Reach Amiable faction with the Knights of Thunder
Obtain 2x Cyclops Skull (from an undead cyclops, Southern Karana)
Turn it in to Thomas in Rathe Mountains for a Mold of Ro Helm
Combine the mold with a Bar of Ronium at a non-cultural forge for the finished Helm of Ro

nodes.label: Mold of Ro Helm
nodes.source: Reward for turning in 2x Cyclops Skull to Thomas (Rathe Mountains, Knights of Thunder faction)

nodes.label: Helm of Ro
nodes.source: Armor of Ro questline reward, combined at a forge from a Mold of Ro Helm + Bar of Ronium

nodes.label: Mold of Ro Vambrace
nodes.description: Marianna's share of the Armor of Ro questline, trading proof of Priests of Life standing for a mold that becomes the Vambraces of Ro.
steps: Reach Amiable faction with the Priests of Life
Obtain 2x Rotten Shark Meat (from a plague shark, Erud's Crossing)
Turn it in to Marianna in Rathe Mountains for a Mold of Ro Vambrace
Combine the mold with a Bar of Ronium at a non-cultural forge for the finished Vambraces of Ro

nodes.label: Mold of Ro Vambrace
nodes.source: Reward for turning in 2x Rotten Shark Meat to Marianna (Rathe Mountains, Priests of Life faction)

nodes.label: Vambraces of Ro
nodes.source: Armor of Ro questline reward, combined at a forge from a Mold of Ro Vambrace + Bar of Ronium

nodes.label: Scrap Metal Quest
nodes.description: Sanfyrd Featherhead buys scrap metal off Ak'Anon's adventurers four pieces at a time for experience, coin, and a chance at real gear -- a repeatable turn-in, not a one-time quest.
steps: Collect scrap metal, four pieces at a time (dropped by rogue clockworks in Steamfont Mountains)

Turn the scrap metal in to Sanfyrd Featherhead in Ak'Anon for experience, coin, and a chance at a named reward -- an Earring of Fire Reflection, a Gnome Glow Rod, a Small Scarab Helm, generic Rusty Weapons, or (rarely) a Tinmizer's Fabulous Compactor

nodes.label: Earring of Fire Reflection
nodes.source: Scrap Metal Quest reward (Sanfyrd Featherhead, Ak'Anon)

nodes.label: Gnome Glow Rod
nodes.source: Scrap Metal Quest reward (Sanfyrd Featherhead, Ak'Anon)

nodes.label: Small Scarab Helm
nodes.source: Scrap Metal Quest reward (Sanfyrd Featherhead, Ak'Anon); also a reward of the Scarab Armor Quests

nodes.label: A Job for Nanrum
nodes.description: Basher Nanrum in Grobb trades three Fire Beetle Eyes at a time for a random 'shiny' reward, while improving your standing with DaBashers at the cost of the Broken Skull Clan.
steps: Hail Basher Nanrum in Grobb and ask 'What job?'
Collect three Fire Beetle Eyes and hand them over
Receive a random reward: a Brass Earring, a Silver Earring, or a raw gem/ore (Cat's Eye Agate, Chunk of Metal Ore, Hematite, or Turquoise)

nodes.label: Brass Earring
nodes.source: A Job for Nanrum reward (Basher Nanrum, Grobb); also drops from the orc taskmaster in Crushbone

nodes.label: Silver Earring
nodes.source: A Job for Nanrum reward (Basher Nanrum, Grobb)

nodes.label: Ale for Beur
nodes.description: Beur Tenlah in East Freeport wants Dwarven Ale delivered -- a fetch quest that also kicks off the Note for Janam chain through Harkin Duskfoot.
steps: Find Beur Tenlah in East Freeport
Obtain Dwarven Ale and deliver it to Beur Tenlah

nodes.label: Used Merchants Gloves
nodes.source: Ale for Beur / Note for Janam reward

nodes.label: Bandages for Honeybugger
nodes.description: Joogl Honeybugger in Misty Thicket was stung collecting bixie honeycombs and needs a bandage -- a one-item turn-in, no combat required, no experience paid.
steps: Hail Joogl Honeybugger in Misty Thicket and ask 'What hurts?'
Give him 1 Bandages

nodes.label: Bug Collection
nodes.description: Blixkin Entopop in Misty Thicket sends adventurers out for six specific bug parts, combined into a box for a random charged trinket reward.
steps: Hail Blixkin Entopop in Misty Thicket to make him stop walking, then work through his dialogue about bugs
Collect a Spiderling Eye, Spiderling Silk, Fire Beetle Eye, Giant Scarab Egg Sack, Giant Fire Beetle Leg, and Giant Wasp Wing
Combine the items into the box he gave you and turn it back in to Blixkin Entopop

nodes.label: Bracelet of Beetlekind
nodes.source: Bug Collection quest reward (Blixkin Entopop, Misty Thicket)

nodes.label: Potion of Poison Warding
nodes.source: Bug Collection quest reward (Blixkin Entopop, Misty Thicket)

nodes.label: Silver Bracelet
nodes.source: Bug Collection quest reward (Blixkin Entopop, Misty Thicket)

nodes.label: Spider Venom
nodes.source: Bug Collection quest reward; also drops from a large widow in Toxxulia Forest

nodes.label: Stalking Probe
nodes.effect: Stalking Probe (Any Slot, Casting Time: Instant)
nodes.source: Bug Collection quest reward (Blixkin Entopop, Misty Thicket); also craftable via Tinkering (trivial 102)

nodes.label: Cat Courier
nodes.description: Antus Shelbra in Paineel's Abattoir sends necromancers to deliver a sealed bag to a contact on Kerra Island and bring back what's handed over in return.
steps: Hail Antus Shelbra on the third floor of the Abattoir in Paineel and receive A Smelly Sealed Bag
Travel to Kerra Island and hand the bag to Kirran Mirrah
Return Karran's Head to Antus Shelbra in Paineel

nodes.label: Errand for Tonmerk
nodes.description: Tonmerk Plorsin in North Qeynos's Temple of Life sends clerics to fetch a reagent flask from Serna Tasknon at the Temple of Marr in Freeport, then back with shark bones and gold for Shark Powder -- a multi-leg errand that pays out the Smite spell.
steps: Speak with Tonmerk Plorsin inside the Temple of Life in North Qeynos and agree to pick up a reagent
Travel to the Temple of Marr in Freeport and give the flask to Serna Tasknon
Gather three shark bones and pay Serna Tasknon ten gold pieces for Shark Powder
Return the Shark Powder to Tonmerk Plorsin in North Qeynos

nodes.label: Errand for Wolten
nodes.description: Wolten Grafe in South Qeynos hands over a scroll for delivery to Eestyana Naestra in West Freeport's Hall of Truth, trading standing with the Freeport Militia and Dismal Rage for goodwill with the Knights of Truth, Priests of Marr, and Steel Warriors.
steps: Receive a scroll from Wolten Grafe in South Qeynos
Deliver the scroll to Eestyana Naestra in the Hall of Truth, West Freeport

nodes.label: Prayer Beads
nodes.source: Errand for Wolten reward (Eestyana Naestra, West Freeport); also drops from Parcil Vinder in Western Plains of Karana

nodes.label: Rusty Morning Star
nodes.source: Errand for Wolten reward (Eestyana Naestra, West Freeport); drops from low-level humanoids in various zones

nodes.label: Small Lantern
nodes.source: Errand for Wolten reward (Eestyana Naestra, West Freeport); also sold by merchants across many zones

nodes.label: Note for Janam
nodes.description: Harkin Duskfoot in the East Freeport tunnels continues the Ale for Beur chain -- deliver ale to Beur Tenlah first, then carry sealed notes between Harkin and Janam Rekish in West Freeport.
steps: Purchase and deliver Dwarven Ale to Beur Tenlah (see Ale for Beur)
Ask Harkin Duskfoot 'What message?' and receive a Note to Janam
Travel to West Freeport and give the note to Janam Rekish
Return Janam's reply note to Harkin Duskfoot in East Freeport

nodes.label: Note for Konem
nodes.description: Phin Esrinap in North Qeynos's monk guild relays notes between himself and Konem Matse in Qeynos Hills and back again -- a two-leg courier errand for monks (or those not already hated by the guild).
steps: Ask Phin Esrinap in the North Qeynos monk's guild 'Where is Konem?' and receive a Message to Konem
Find Konem Matse in Qeynos Hills and give him the note
Receive Grathin's Invoice from Konem Matse and return it to Phin

nodes.label: Water Flask
nodes.source: Note for Konem reward (Phin Esrinap, North Qeynos); also sold by merchants across many zones; also brewed via Brewing (trivial 21, from 4x Pod of Water)

nodes.label: Note for Rebby
nodes.description: Nestral TGaza in the East Freeport tunnels sends a runner to Rebby and Janam in West Freeport with a message, then back with Rebby's Rat Whiskers -- geared toward evil and neutral classes.
steps: Hail Nestral TGaza in the East Freeport tunnels and agree to help
Carry a Message to Rebby to Rebby and Janam in West Freeport
Receive Rebby's Rat Whiskers and return them to Nestral TGaza

nodes.label: Aenia and Behroe
nodes.description: Behroe Dlexon in South Qeynos asks a bard to carry a ballad to Aenia Ghenson in North Qeynos and bring back her reply.
steps: Hail Behroe Dlexon in South Qeynos and receive the ballad 'The Thornless Rose'
Travel to North Qeynos and recite the ballad to Aenia Ghenson
Receive a Letter to Behroe and return it to Behroe Dlexon

nodes.label: Shawl of the Wind Spirit
nodes.source: Aenia and Behroe reward (Behroe Dlexon, South Qeynos)

nodes.label: Air Tight Box Quest
nodes.description: Larkon Theardor in Ak'Anon sends adventurers to Fodin Frugrin at the Steamfont Mountains observatory for an Air Tight Box, then to fill it with infected rat livers and bring it back.
steps: Hail Larkon Theardor in Ak'Anon and ask for the clean tasks
Travel to Steamfont Mountains and find Fodin Frugrin at the observatory
Receive an Air Tight Box and combine 10 Infected Rat Livers (looted from infected rats in Steamfont Mountains) inside it
Return the completed box to Larkon Theardor

nodes.label: Aviak Chicks
nodes.description: Bumle Reminjar in North Kaladim's Paladin guild trades krag chick talons for a random piece of Small Patchwork armor.
steps: Hail Bumle Reminjar in the Paladin guild dining hall, North Kaladim, and agree to destroy the krag chicks
Collect 4 Aviak Chick Talons, looted from a Krag Chick or aviak chick in Butcherblock Mountains
Hand over the talons for a random reward

nodes.label: Small Patchwork Boots
nodes.source: Aviak Chicks reward (Bumle Reminjar, North Kaladim); part of the Small Patchwork Armor Set

nodes.label: Small Patchwork Cloak
nodes.source: Aviak Chicks reward (Bumle Reminjar, North Kaladim); part of the Small Patchwork Armor Set

nodes.label: Small Patchwork Pants
nodes.source: Aviak Chicks reward (Bumle Reminjar, North Kaladim); part of the Small Patchwork Armor Set

nodes.label: Small Patchwork Sleeves
nodes.source: Aviak Chicks reward (Bumle Reminjar, North Kaladim); part of the Small Patchwork Armor Set

nodes.label: Small Patchwork Tunic
nodes.source: Aviak Chicks reward (Bumle Reminjar, North Kaladim); part of the Small Patchwork Armor Set

nodes.label: Aviak Talons
nodes.description: Bumle Reminjar in North Kaladim also buys krag elder talons off adventurers, for coin and faction rather than gear.
steps: Collect 4 Aviak Talons, looted from a krag elder in southern Butcherblock Mountains between Greater Faydark and Dagnor's Cauldron
Hand the talons to Bumle Reminjar in North Kaladim

nodes.label: Bandit Sashes
nodes.description: Chesgard Sydwen, in South Qeynos's house of thunder, rewards adventurers for thinning out the bandits, brigands, highwaymen, and raiders of the Karanas -- repeatable, one bronze weapon per sash.
steps: Kill bandits, brigands, highwaymen, or raiders in the Karanas and loot a Bandit Sash
Turn the sash in to Chesgard Sydwen in South Qeynos for a bronze weapon, coin, and faction (repeatable for more of each)

nodes.label: Bandit Spectacles
nodes.description: Gehna Solbenya in South Qeynos sends adventurers to hunt bandit healers in the Plains of Karana for their spectacles, paying out coin and a choice of starter spell per hand-in.
steps: Hail Gehna Solbenya in South Qeynos and agree to hunt bandit binders
Travel to the Plains of Karana and collect spectacles from bandit healers
Return two spectacles to Gehna Solbenya for coin, faction, and a random spell scroll

nodes.label: Barnacle Breastplate Quest
nodes.description: Weligon Steelherder, in Erudin's Deepwater Knights guild, sends adventurers of at least Amiable faction to hunt a diseased shark and her young for a Barnacle Breastplate.
steps: Speak to Weligon Steelherder about ocean protection and agree to hunt the diseased shark
Receive an Empty Shark Bag, a 4-slot Small container
Collect the Heretic Shark Skin and three Baby Shark Remains, and combine them in the bag
Return the Bag of Shark Remains to Weligon Steelherder

nodes.label: Barnacle Breastplate
nodes.source: Barnacle Breastplate Quest reward (Weligon Steelherder, Erudin)

nodes.label: Basilisk Tongues
nodes.description: Larkon Theardor in Ak'Anon trades four basilisk tongues for a random starter caster spell.
steps: Travel beyond Ak'Anon and hunt basilisks for their tongues
Return 4 Basilisk Tongues to Larkon Theardor for a random spell

nodes.label: Bat Wings
nodes.description: Niola Impholder in the Felwithe Magician's Guild trades four bat wings for a starter spell.
steps: Hail Niola Impholder in the Felwithe Magician's Guild, Southern Felwithe
Collect 4 Bat Wings (unstacked) and hand them over for a spell

nodes.label: Bearskin Gloves Quest
nodes.description: Ged Twigborn in Kithicor Forest crafts Bearskin Gloves for 25 gold plus a High Quality Bear Skin.
steps: Collect a High Quality Bear Skin (from a brown bear, bear cub, black bear, or polar bear)
Pay Ged Twigborn 25 gold and hand over the bear skin for a pair of Bearskin Gloves

nodes.label: Bearskin Gloves
nodes.source: Bearskin Gloves Quest reward (Ged Twigborn, Kithicor Forest)

nodes.label: Blessed Oil Quest
nodes.description: Brother Estle, on the road in Western Karana, sends clerics of at least Amiable faction on a relay through North Qeynos's Temple of Life and Splitpaw Lair for spells and a final Temple reward.
steps: Find Brother Estle on the road in Western Karana and discuss the blessed oil
Travel to the Temple of Life in North Qeynos and speak with Priestess Jahnda, who directs you to Nomsoe Jusagta
Accept the Blessed Oil Flask from Nomsoe and deliver it to Brother Estle, receiving Prayer Beads in return
Deliver the beads to Priestess Jahnda and receive a Temple Summons
Carry the summons to Brother Hayle in Splitpaw Lair and receive a key
Trade the key with Tyokan Mekase at the Temple shop for a final random cleric spell

nodes.label: Blurred Map Quest
nodes.description: Tabure Ahendle in South Qeynos's Steel Warriors Arena trades a blurred map, looted from a zombie sailor in Erud's Crossing, for coin and a random weapon -- requires at least Amiable faction.
steps: Loot a Blurred Map from a zombie sailor in Erud's Crossing
Hand the map to Tabure Ahendle in the South Qeynos Steel Warriors Arena

nodes.label: Cast-Iron Long Sword
nodes.source: Blurred Map Quest reward (Tabure Ahendle, South Qeynos)

nodes.label: Cast-Iron Mace
nodes.source: Blurred Map Quest reward (Tabure Ahendle, South Qeynos)

nodes.label: Bone Granite Powder Quest
nodes.description: Jondin in West Cabilis trades a forged Bone Granite Powder for the Kromdul Toothpick, a shaman piercing weapon.
steps: Hail Jondin in West Cabilis
Combine 1 Pile of Granite Pebbles, 2 Bone Chips, and 1 Forging Hammer in a Forge (Trivial: 21) to produce Bone Granite Powder
Give the Bone Granite Powder to Jondin

nodes.label: Kromdul Toothpick
nodes.source: Bone Granite Powder Quest reward (Jondin, West Cabilis)

nodes.label: Bottle of Red Wine
nodes.description: Lokar To`Biath, in the library of Neriak's 3rd Gate, trades up to four bottles of Red Wine for coin-free faction -- no negative faction consequences.
steps: Find Lokar To`Biath in the library of Neriak 3rd Gate
Hand her a Red Wine (up to 4, unstacked)

nodes.label: Book of Turmoil Quest
nodes.description: Lokar To`Biath in Neriak's 3rd Gate library sends paladins on a dark chain through his own sister Rysva and the Oracle of K`Arnon at Ocean of Tears, culminating in slaying Lokar himself.
steps: Hand Lokar To`Biath 70 gold in the library of Neriak 3rd Gate
Give the note from her brother to Rysva To`Biath in the Blind Fish Tavern
Return to Lokar and slay him, then loot his Decapitated Head
Hand the head and note to Rysva
Travel to Ocean of Tears and give the Book of Turmoil to the Oracle of K`Arnon

nodes.label: Glowing Torch
nodes.source: Book of Turmoil Quest reward; also drops from Tisella in Lavastorm Mountains

nodes.label: Bozinite Pestle Quest
nodes.description: Larkon Theardor in Ak'Anon sends adventurers to Myre in North Kaladim for a Bozinite Pestle, taken off a mining-bridge mob, for coin and a random mage spell.
steps: Speak with Larkon Theardor in Ak'Anon and agree to visit Myre in North Kaladim
Find Myre in North Kaladim and ask for the bozinite pestles
Kill Cleaner VII on the North Kaladim mining bridge to obtain the Bozinite Pestle
Return the pestle to Larkon Theardor

nodes.label: Bracers of Erollisi Quest
nodes.description: Styria Fearnon, on the hill above the Sisters of Erollisi dock in Ocean of Tears, sends adventurers two islands west to Capt Surestout on the Isle of the Seafoam Cyclops for the Bracers of Erollisi.
steps: Find Styria Fearnon on the hill next to the dock, Ocean of Tears
Travel two islands west to the Isle of the Seafoam Cyclops and obtain the Bracers of Erollisi from Capt Surestout
Return the bracers to Styria Fearnon for a random trinket reward

nodes.label: Broken Lute
nodes.description: Cassius Messus, in South Qeynos's bard guild, sends bards to deliver the Lisera Lute to Vhalen Nostrolo in Southern Karana and carry his reply back for the Hymn of Restoration.
steps: Take the Lisera Lute to Vhalen Nostrolo, composing in the Southern Karana plains near the well
Give him the lute and receive a note
Return the note to Cassius Messus in South Qeynos

nodes.label: Brother Trintle (Quest)
nodes.description: Suuspa Clanim, in North Qeynos's Temple of Life, sends adventurers to hunt down Brother Trintle, a temple member gone bad, in West Karana.
steps: Tell Suuspa Clanim in the Temple of Life, North Qeynos, that Brother Trintle attacked Brother Estle
Kill Brother Trintle in West Karana and loot his Busted Prayer Beads
Return the beads to Suuspa Clanim

nodes.label: Cabilis Pale Ale (Cabilis)
nodes.description: Grype, found at night in East Cabilis's Tink 'N Babble, trades four Cabilis Pale Ales for a copper piece and a burp -- no faction or experience.
steps: Find Grype in the Tink 'N Babble at night, East Cabilis
Buy four Cabilis Pale Ales and give them to him

nodes.label: Call of Flame Quest
nodes.description: Lily Ashwood in Greater Faydark sends high-level rangers on a long relay through Ganelorn Oast in East Karana, Kithicor Forest, North Kaladim, Nagafen's Lair, and Lower Guk, ending with the Call of Flame spell.
steps: Get a sealed Love Letter from Lily Ashwood in Greater Faydark
Give the letter to Ganelorn Oast in East Karana and receive Albino Rattlesnake Eggs
Take the eggs to Kithicor in Kithicor Forest and receive a Symbol of Achievement
Return the symbol to Ganelorn Oast and receive a Note of Credit
Take the note to Aanina Rockfinder in North Kaladim and receive a Gift
Collect a Burnt Sash from Nagafen's Lair, an Adamantite Band from Lower Guk, and an Electrum-Bladed Wakizashi
Give the sash, band, wakizashi, and gift to Ganelorn Oast
Kill Vance Bearstalker and loot his head
Give the head to Ganelorn Oast and receive the Call of Flame spell

nodes.label: Captain Nealith's Brother
nodes.description: Captain Nealith in Firiona Vie, first met during the Drolvarg Teeth quest, sends adventurers after a drolvarg scavenger for word of his missing siblings.
steps: Clear the fixed drolvarg spawns at the twin tents until a drolvarg scavenger appears
Kill the scavenger and loot a Bloodsoaked Note
Give the note to Captain Nealith in Firiona Vie

nodes.label: Glaive of Marltek
nodes.source: Captain Nealith's Brother reward (Captain Nealith, Firiona Vie)

nodes.label: Catfish Tail
nodes.description: Vynon Estaliun in Erudin sends adventurers to Kerra Ridge in Toxxulia Forest to slay a catfisher for its tail.
steps: Hail Vynon Estaliun in Erudin and agree to face fear
Travel to Kerra Ridge in Toxxulia Forest and slay a catfisher
Loot a Fishy Cat Tail and hand it in to Vynon Estaliun

nodes.label: Brass Ring
nodes.source: Catfish Tail reward (Vynon Estaliun, Erudin); also a reward of Taxes and Wenbie's Muffins

nodes.label: Torch
nodes.source: Catfish Tail reward (Vynon Estaliun, Erudin); also sold by merchants across many zones

nodes.label: Cannibalize II (Good)
nodes.description: Marlyn McMerin in Firiona Vie sends high-level shamans across City of Mist, Timorous Deep, Trakanon's Teeth, and Karnor's Castle for four reagents that teach Cannibalize II.
steps: Obtain Strange Ochre Clay from an army behemoth in City of Mist
Obtain Crushed Diamonds, a ground spawn in Timorous Deep
Obtain Yun Shaman Powder from a froglok yun shaman in Trakanon's Teeth
Obtain Greyish Bone Chips from a skeletal warlord in Karnor's Castle
Give all four items to Marlyn McMerin in Firiona Vie

nodes.label: Cheslin's Illusion Cards
nodes.description: Chesgard Sydwen in South Qeynos sends adventurers to escort his son, Guard Cheslin, on patrol through Qeynos Hills and collect the illusion cards he drops along the way.
steps: Hail Chesgard Sydwen in South Qeynos and learn about his son Cheslin
Find Guard Cheslin in a tower in Qeynos Hills and escort him on patrol
Collect the four illusion cards he drops (Chrono Cyclone, Diamond Vale, Ebon Lotus, Library of Erudin) and return them to him
Deliver Cheslin's letter back to Chesgard Sydwen for a piece of Raw Hide armor

nodes.label: Acumen Mask Quest
nodes.description: Vilissia in the Temple of Solusek Ro sends wizards after four cursed relics -- a Glowing Mask, a Patch of Shadow, a Darkbone Skull, and a Bonechipped Mask -- for the Acumen Mask.
steps: Obtain a Glowing Mask from a skeleton monk or A Froglok Scryer in Upper Guk
Obtain a Patch of Shadow from a shadowed man
Obtain a Darkbone Skull from a greater dark bone in The Estate of Unrest
Obtain a Bonechipped Mask from A Goblin Headmaster in Ocean of Tears
Return all four items to Vilissia

nodes.label: Acumen Mask
nodes.effect: Gaze (Any Slot/Can Equip, Casting Time: Instant) at Level 20
nodes.source: Acumen Mask Quest reward (Vilissia, Temple of Solusek Ro)

nodes.label: Aegis of Life Quest
nodes.description: Capt Linarius, on the bridge to South Karana, sends clerics and paladins after Lord Grimrot -- requires Warmly faction with Camlend Serbold in Qeynos to complete the turn-in, or the quest items are lost.
steps: Speak with Capt Linarius on the bridge to South Karana and travel to Qeynos to tell Camlend Serbold of Lord Grimrot
Find Lord Grimrot in the Plains of Karana and defeat both his living and undead forms
Loot the Pestilence Scythe (living) and Decaying Heart (undead)
Return both items to Camlend Serbold in the Qeynos priest guild (requires Warmly faction)

nodes.label: Aegis of Life
nodes.source: Aegis of Life Quest reward (Capt Linarius / Camlend Serbold)

nodes.label: Assist the Great Xelha
nodes.description: Xelha Nevagon in East Freeport trades bone chips, fire beetle eyes, and spiderling silk for starter necromancer spells and a trinket.
steps: Collect 4 Bone Chips (unstacked), 4 Fire Beetle Eyes, and 4 Spiderling Silk
Hand all three turn-ins to Xelha Nevagon in East Freeport

nodes.label: Xelha's Sparkler
nodes.source: Assist the Great Xelha reward (Xelha Nevagon, East Freeport)

nodes.label: Azraxs' Legacy
nodes.description: Ernax the Scholar in Paineel sends high-level Erudite necromancers of at least Kindly faction with the Heretics on a three-relic hunt for the Mantle of Souls, ending at a Tormented Soul in Paineel.
steps: Receive A Tattered Book from Ernax and return it for a Soul Trap, a 4-slot container
Obtain a Bloody Mantle from a Dark Assassin
Obtain the Heart of the Pure Druid from Alania Peaceheart
Obtain an Empty Crystal Sphere from Jalen Goldsinger (via the Crystal sub-quest: 500 gold to Gorth Bearsoul, then 1000 gold plus a Potion of Sorrow to Jalen Goldsinger)
Combine the Bloody Mantle, Heart of the Pure Druid, and Empty Crystal Sphere in the Soul Trap
Give the completed Soul Trap to a Tormented Soul in Paineel

nodes.label: Mantle of Souls
nodes.source: Azraxs' Legacy reward (Ernax the Scholar, Paineel)

nodes.label: Azzar's Dreadful Hat Quest
nodes.description: Azzar Habbib, a Heretic overlooking Paineel's newbie grounds, sends adventurers of at least Indifferent faction to The Warrens for the Cave Bat Lord's dropped hat.
steps: Hail Azzar Habbib in Paineel
Travel to The Warrens and find the Cave Bat Lord past the King's Throne Room
Kill the Cave Bat Lord and loot Azzar's Dreadful Hat
Return the hat to Azzar Habbib

nodes.label: Black Lace Sash
nodes.source: Azzar's Dreadful Hat Quest reward (Azzar Habbib, Paineel)

nodes.label: Bandit Sisters
nodes.description: Tynkale in Northern Felwithe sends adventurers to Kelethin, then the Nybright sisters' bandit camp in Lesser Faydark, for a random piece of leather or patchwork armor.
steps: Travel to Kelethin and speak with Tandan Nybright, who reeks of elven wine
Find the Nybright sisters' camp in Lesser Faydark, near the entrance to Mistmoore Castle
Kill Jayla, Kayla, Shayla, and Tayla Nybright for a chance at a Dull Pearl Necklace each

Return to Kelethin and hand a drunkard 4 Dull Pearl Necklaces for a random reward (Bearskin Gloves, Leather Belt, Leather Leggings, Leather Shoulderpads, Targ Shield, Small Leather Gorget, Small Leather Mask, or Small Leather Shoulderpads)

nodes.label: Bard Reports
nodes.description: Jusean Evanesque in South Qeynos relays watch reports between the docks and North Qeynos's gate guards -- a simple two-leg courier errand.
steps: Speak with Jusean Evanesque in South Qeynos and receive a Watch Report Request
Carry it to the requested guard (Behroe Dlexon or Anehan Treol at the docks, or Leanon Ruksey/Quinon Hulleaf at North Qeynos's gate) and receive their report
Return the report to Jusean Evanesque

nodes.label: Bat Fur Quest
nodes.description: Caleah Herblender in South Qeynos's Herb Jar trades newbie-zone drops -- two Bat Fur, a Rat Whisker, and a Fire Beetle Eye, handed in that exact order -- for coin and faction.
steps: Collect two Bat Fur, a Rat Whisker, and a Fire Beetle Eye from the newbie mobs outside Qeynos's north gate
Hand the items to Caleah Herblender in South Qeynos's Herb Jar, in that order

nodes.label: Bear Hide Armor
nodes.description: Chanda Miller, camped outside Surefall Glade, crafts bear-hide armor pieces for gold plus a matching-quality bear skin.
steps: Pay Chanda Miller 5 gold and a Low Quality Bear Skin for Bear-hide Boots
Pay 15 gold and a Medium Quality Bear Skin for Bear-hide Boots
Pay 21 gold and a High Quality Bear Skin for a Bear-hide Cape

nodes.label: Bear-hide Belt
nodes.source: Bear Hide Armor reward (Chanda Miller, Surefall Glade)

nodes.label: Bear-hide Boots
nodes.source: Bear Hide Armor reward (Chanda Miller, Surefall Glade)

nodes.label: Bear-hide Cape
nodes.source: Bear Hide Armor reward (Chanda Miller, Surefall Glade)

nodes.label: Beguile Plants Quest
nodes.description: Shrub Marwood, in Firiona Vie's eastern outpost hideout, sends high-level druids across Lake of Ill Omen, Frontier Mountains, Firiona Vie, and the Sebilis-area zones for four reagents that teach Beguile Plants.
steps: Obtain a Farsight Crystal from a Sarnak revealer at the Sarnak Fort, Lake of Ill Omen
Obtain a Pouch of Dust from a sarnak partisan in Frontier Mountains
Obtain Tsu Shaman Powder from a Froglok Tsu Shaman in Firiona Vie
Obtain Strathbone Silk from a strathbone spider in Kaesora, Droga, or Nurga
Turn all four items in to Shrub Marwood for a Fertile Crop and the Beguile Plants spell scroll

nodes.label: Behead the Freeport Militia
nodes.description: Jemoz Lerkarson, a cleric guildmaster in North Freeport's Temple of Marr, sends clerics to West Freeport to defeat the Militia's own Captain Hazran for a random cleric spell.
steps: Hand a Damaged Militia Helm to Jemoz Lerkarson in the Temple of Marr, North Freeport
Travel to West Freeport and defeat Captain Hazran, the Militia House's Warrior guildmaster
Loot his Human Head and return it to Jemoz Lerkarson

nodes.label: Black Wolf Skin Quest
nodes.description: Tarker Blazetoss in Southern Felwithe's Wizard's Guild trades a single Black Wolf Skin for a random reward -- he eats any extras for nothing.
steps: Hail Tarker Blazetoss in the Southern Felwithe Wizard's Guild and agree to perform a task
Hand him one Black Wolf Skin at a time for a random reward

nodes.label: Copper Band
nodes.source: Black Wolf Skin Quest reward (Tarker Blazetoss, Southern Felwithe)

nodes.label: Rusty Dagger
nodes.source: Black Wolf Skin Quest reward (Tarker Blazetoss, Southern Felwithe)

nodes.label: Worn Great Staff
nodes.source: Black Wolf Skin Quest reward (Tarker Blazetoss, Southern Felwithe)

nodes.label: Blackburrow Brewers
nodes.description: Larsk Juton in Surefall Glade sends druids and rangers into Blackburrow's third level for three Blackburrow Casks -- a rare drop from gnoll brewers, guaranteed from the Master Brewer.
steps: Collect 3 Blackburrow Casks from gnoll brewers on Blackburrow's third level (guaranteed from the Master Brewer)
Turn the casks in to Larsk Juton in Surefall Glade for a Cloak of Jaggedpine

nodes.label: Cloak of Jaggedpine
nodes.source: Blackburrow Brewers reward (Larsk Juton, Surefall Glade)

nodes.label: Blank Scrolls
nodes.description: Kazlo Naedra of the Order of Three, in South Qeynos, is short on blank scroll sheets and pays for a supply run to Sequea Erthinon in Surefall Glade.
steps: Hail Kazlo Naedra in South Qeynos and learn of the blank scroll sheet shortage
Travel to Surefall Glade and buy sheets from Sequea Erthinon for 1 silver 5 copper
Return the sheets to Kazlo Naedra for reimbursement and faction

nodes.label: Broom Of Trilon Quest
nodes.description: Vira, on the Temple of Solusek Ro's balcony, sends magicians after a star ruby, a griffon feather, a Najena magician's broom, and cyclops toes for the Broom of Trilon.
steps: Collect a star ruby, a feather from a griffon, a broom from a magician in Najena, and the toes of a cyclops
Return all four items to Vira on the Temple of Solusek Ro's balcony

nodes.label: Broom of Trilon
nodes.effect: Reclaim Energy (Any Slot, Casting Time: Instant) at Level 20
nodes.source: Broom Of Trilon Quest reward (Vira, Temple of Solusek Ro); Minion of Air focus effect

nodes.label: Bugglegupp (Quest)
nodes.description: Tergon Brenclog in Ak'Anon's Library Mechanamagica sends magicians to Steamfont Mountains to kill the troll Bugglegupp for its Iron Pellet, in exchange for a random starter caster spell.
steps: Hail Tergon Brenclog in Ak'Anon and agree to help
Travel to Steamfont Mountains and kill the troll Bugglegupp
Loot the Iron Pellet and return it to Tergon Brenclog

nodes.label: Caduceus of Sacrament Quest
nodes.description: Gavel the Temperant in the Temple of Solusek Ro sends clerics after two Magnetized Platinum Bars, an Icon of Sacrament from Mistmoore Castle's jail, and an Ingot of Sacrament from Rathe Mountains for the Caduceus of Sacrament.
steps: Obtain 2 Magnetized Platinum Bars
Obtain the Icon of Sacrament, a ground spawn in Mistmoore Castle's jail
Obtain the Ingot of Sacrament, dropped by a Giant Skeleton in the Rathe Mountains ruins
Turn in all three items to Gavel the Temperant in the Temple of Solusek Ro

nodes.label: Caduceus of Sacrament
nodes.source: Caduceus of Sacrament Quest reward (Gavel the Temperant, Temple of Solusek Ro)

nodes.label: Catfish Croak Sandwich Quest
nodes.description: Klok Foob in Lake of Ill Omen wants two Catfish Croak Sandwiches, each combined from a sewer catfish, thin sliced froglok, shrub lettuce, and honey mush bread.
steps: Catch a Sewer Catfish (fishable in Cabilis and Firiona Vie)
Obtain thin sliced froglok from a lizard, Shrub Lettuce from Man Eating Shrubs in Swamp of No Hope, and Honey Mush Bread from Klok Bygle
Combine a sharpening stone with the ingredients in a forge (Trivial 26) to make a Sharp Cutting Disk, then combine all four into a Catfish Croak Sandwich
Give two sandwiches to Klok Foob

nodes.label: Foobscale Coif
nodes.source: Catfish Croak Sandwich Quest reward (Klok Foob, Lake of Ill Omen)

nodes.label: Catman Alliance
nodes.description: Aderius Rhenar, in The Warrens' prison area, sends a message ahead of his return to Erudin -- deliver it to Leraena Shelyrak in the Temple of Divine Light.
steps: Hail Aderius Rhenar in The Warrens and agree to help him return to Erudin
Receive a Rolled Up Strip of Cloth
Deliver it to Leraena Shelyrak in Erudin's Temple of Divine Light

nodes.label: Cindl's Polar Bear Collection
nodes.description: Cindl, inside Mac's Kilts in Halas, trades a Polar Bear Skin for a random piece of used armor -- repeatable, and doable even at dubious faction.
steps: Collect a Polar Bear Skin from a glacier bear, polar bear, or polar bear cub in Everfrost Peaks
Hand the skin to Cindl inside Mac's Kilts, Halas, for a random piece of armor (Large Patchwork or Large Tattered armor set pieces, or Raw-hide Leggings) and a gold piece

nodes.label: Clay Bracelet Quest
nodes.description: Joyce, guardian of the elementalist's relics in the Temple of Solusek Ro, sends magicians after four Runes of Clay -- three from gnomish necromancers in Rathe Mountains, one from a goblin headmaster in Ocean of Tears.
steps: Obtain the Top rune from Findlegrob in Rathe Mountains
Obtain the Right rune from Bindlegrob in Rathe Mountains
Obtain the Left rune from Sindlegrob in Rathe Mountains
Obtain the Bottom rune from a goblin headmaster in Ocean of Tears
Return all four Runes of Clay to Joyce for a Clay Bracelet

nodes.label: Clay Bracelet
nodes.effect: Eye of Zomm (Any Slot/Can Equip, Casting Time: Instant) at Level 20
nodes.source: Clay Bracelet Quest reward (Joyce, Temple of Solusek Ro)

nodes.label: Cleanse the Ocean
nodes.description: Laoni Reista, on the Deepwater Knights' first floor in Erudin, sends adventurers into Erudin Bay to intercept Qeynosian smugglers for a random piece of Small Patchwork armor.
steps: Kill smugglers in the waters near Erudin's harbor for a chance at A Nicked Coin
Hand the coin to Laoni Reista for coin, faction, and a random piece of Small Patchwork armor

nodes.label: Coin of Tash (Tashania)
nodes.description: Romar Sunto in the Temple of Solusek Ro sends enchanters on a ten-city coin collection, three librarian hand-offs, and a final return for the Tashania spell.
steps: Get a Coin Pouch from Romar Sunto in the Temple of Solusek Ro
Collect An Old Silver Coin from each of ten cities: Ak'Anon, Erudin Palace, Northern Felwithe, West Freeport, Grobb, Halas, South Kaladim, Neriak Commons, Oggok, and North Qeynos
Combine the 10 coins in the coin pouch for a Coin of Tash
Give it to Tarn Visilin in High Keep's library for a Glowing Coin of Tash
Give that to Mizr N'Mar in Neriak 3rd Gate's library for a Gleaming Coin of Tash
Give that to Raine Beteria in Erudin's library for a Radiant Coin of Tash
Return to Romar Sunto for the Tashania spell

nodes.label: Cold Iron
nodes.description: Royal Guard Sheltuin in Paineel sends shadow knights through The Warrens, Keletha Nightweaver, Qeynos Hills, and Everfrost's Eichvul for the Leggings of Ridossan.
steps: Loot a Large Empty Crate from Smithy Rrarrgin in The Warrens and return it to Royal Guard Sheltuin
Take the sample to Keletha Nightweaver
Travel to Qeynos Hills and kill the erudite traveler by the lake for a Courier's Head, Crate full of Ore, and a Note from Eichvul
Find and kill Eichvul, a dark elf near Everfrost's Permafrost entrance, for a Supplier's Head and Sealed Letter
Return all four items to Royal Guard Sheltuin in Paineel

nodes.label: Leggings of Ridossan
nodes.source: Cold Iron reward (Royal Guard Sheltuin, Paineel)

nodes.label: Collect Drops of Shadow
nodes.description: Ssynthi, in the graveyard behind Mistmoore Castle's mausoleum, sends adventurers to every shadowed-men camp across Norrath, then to Rathe Mountains' Ytyrs the Reborn, for a Penumbral Rod.
steps: Receive an 8-slot Cauldron of Shadow Essence from Ssynthi
Collect a vial from each shadowed men camp: Innothule Swamp, Nektulos Forest, Lavastorm Mountains, Lesser Faydark, South Karana, Commonlands, and Kithicor Forest
Find and kill Ytyrs the Reborn in Rathe Mountains
Combine all eight vials in the cauldron to craft a Concoction of Shadow
Give the Concoction to Ssynthi

nodes.label: Tome of Order and Discord
nodes.source: Become PvP quest reward (Priest of Discord)

nodes.label: Become PvP (Ak'Anon)
nodes.description: The Priest of Discord in Ak'Anon offers the Tome of Order and Discord -- reading it and handing it back flags your character for player-versus-player combat: your name displays in red instead of blue, you become vulnerable to other PvP-flagged players, and you lose access to beneficial spells from non-PvP characters.
steps: Hail the Priest of Discord
Request to read the Tome of Order and Discord
Hand the tome back to the Priest of Discord to complete the quest

Hand the tome back to the Priest of Discord to complete the quest

Request to read the Tome of Order and Discord
Hand the tome back to the Priest of Discord to complete the quest

nodes.label: Animal Skin Armor
nodes.description: Ergrez Shortpaw in Iceclad Ocean trades hunted pelts and reinforcing materials for five separate pieces of animal-skin armor -- each piece its own turn-in. All rewards are NO DROP.
steps: Cougarskin Sleeves: give 1 Low Quality Cougarskin + 1 Fatty Walrus Meat
Cougarskin Boots: give 1 Medium Quality Cougarskin + 2 Cutting Shells
Cougarskin Mask: give 1 High Quality Cougarskin + 2 Mammoth Meats
Direwolf Fur Hood: give 1 Low Quality Dire Wolf Fur + 2 Bark Bindings
Direwolf Fur Cloak: give 1 Medium Quality Dire Wolf Fur + 2 Skinning Rocks

nodes.label: Armor of the Priest Quests
nodes.description: Blaize the Radiant and Gavel the Temperant in the Temple of Solusek Ro each offer cleric armor-piece turn-ins; the full set (all six pieces) gives AC +85, STA +8, WIS +10, DEX +5, AGI +5, INT +5, plus elemental resistances and disease protection.
steps: Blaize the Radiant: Greaves of the Penitent
Blaize the Radiant: Vambraces of the Fervent
Blaize the Radiant: Boots of the Reliant
Blaize the Radiant: Gauntlets of the Ardent
Gavel the Temperant: Chestplate of the Constant (needs 2x Galvanized Platinum Bar, an icon from Sludge Dankmire in Clan Runnyeye, and an ingot from Dwigus Lowater in Dagnor's Cauldron)
Gavel the Temperant: Bracers of the Reverent

nodes.label: Azzar's Dreadful Hat, Part 2

Disciple Symbol: kill Master Whoopal for his head, retrieve halfling spy orders in disguise, then kill the spy

Regent Symbol: obtain an odd cold iron necklace, travel to Freeport and Ak'Anon for information, then retrieve an encrypted document from Steamfont Mountains

steps: Obtain a Shadowed Scythe from a shadowed man (found in West Commonlands, Lavastorm Mountains, Lesser Faydark, or Nektulos Forest) and give it to Vurgo
Collect a Fungus Eye from a Mortuary Fungus in The Estate of Unrest and a Shadowed Knife from a goblin headmaster in Ocean of Tears

nodes.label: Incandescent Armor Quests
nodes.description: Sultin in the Temple of Solusek Ro trades enchanters three separate item bundles for the Incandescent Mask, Incandescent Gloves, and Incandescent Wand.
steps: Mask: obtain a Glowing Mask (a skeleton monk or a froglok scryer, Upper Guk) and three Runes of Fortune (one from Enynti, two purchased for 50gp each from Mizr N'Mar and Madame Serena); turn in to Sultin, who requires good faction to complete this trade

Gloves: obtain Glowing Gloves (a shadowed man), Radiant Gloves (Radiant, in the Temple of Cazic Thule), Enchanted Gloves (50gp to Tizina), and Gleaming Gloves (a bloodstone to Tarn Visilin); turn all four in to Sultin

Wand: retrieve a Pouch of Silver Dust from a dusty werebat in The Estate of Unrest and a Silver Wand from a silvered guard in the Temple of Cazic Thule, have Ezmirella and Raine Beteria enchant it, then return both items to Sultin

steps: Vrynn: Totemic Boots (Banded Boots, Dufrenite, Terror Spines -- from a tentacle terror in either Najena or The Estate of Unrest -- and a Chief's Tongue from an orc chief in Lesser Faydark)

nodes.label: Captain Nalot's Triple Strength Rum
nodes.description: Nilham the Chef in Iceclad Ocean sends players on a long fetch-and-craft chain across the frozen north, trading components up through several NPCs to finally deliver rum to Captain Nalot and get a reward from Nelet Durzit at the docks. Requires Amiable or better with Thurgadin residents for one step.
steps: Collect two Barracuda Livers from coldwater barracudas in Cobalt Scar; trade to Qarrgy Scallopgobbler for a Bladder of Acidic Ooze
Forage Fresh Tree Sap in The Wakening Land
Give the sap and bladder to Pythic Urson in Thurgadin for Dissolving Liquid
Give the dissolving liquid to a gnomish deserter in Great Divide for a Locked Rum Box
Collect four Fresh Chunks of Wooly Rhino from Eastern Wastes; trade to Mist Panther in The Wakening Land for a Golden Broken Key
Obtain a High Quality Dire Wolf Fur; trade to Errgriz in Iceclad Ocean for Wolf Fur Earcovers
Give the earcovers to Sojan the Sleepless for a Fine Gold Chain
Give the chain and key to Sojan the Sleepless for a Rum Box Key
Give the key and locked box to Captain Nalot for Capt. Nalot's Triple Strength Rum
Give the rum to Nelet Durzit at the docks for the final reward

nodes.label: Rough Silver Chain
nodes.source: Captain Nalot's Triple Strength Rum reward (Nelet Durzit, Iceclad Ocean docks)

nodes.label: Chalice of Conquest Quest
nodes.description: Dru Razbind in Butcherblock Mountains sends paladins Amiable or better with the Paladins of Underfoot through a long chain: assemble and combine candlestick pieces into a Candle of Bravery, resurrect Captain Klunga to obtain the Chalice of Conquest, then trade up through two more NPCs for the final reward.
steps: Obtain the Stem and Foot of Candlestick from Nicholas and the Unkempt Druids in Rathe Mountains
Collect an Abandoned Orc Shovel from Lake Rathetear and acquire Klunga's Bracelet from Nicholas
Obtain Soil of Underfoot via a sub-quest with Priestess Ghalea, and a Honeycomb
Combine the candlestick pieces with the Soil of Underfoot and Honeycomb at Dok in Halas for a Candle of Bravery
Loot a Blood Stained Note from an Exiled Legionnaire in Dagnor's Cauldron
Trade the note, Klunga's Bracelet, and 100 gold to Ghilanbiddle Nylwadil to resurrect Captain Klunga
Give the Abandoned Orc Shovel to Captain Klunga, follow him, and defeat him for the Chalice of Conquest
Combine the Chalice of Conquest with the Candle of Bravery in a Chalice Case
Turn in the Chalice Case to Datur Nightseer for a Cape of Underfoot
Return the cape to Dru Razbind for the final reward

Obtain a Ring of Evoluoy from an alligator in Temple of Cazic Thule

Find and defeat Drosco in room 7 of the Qeynos Catacombs
Loot A Sealed Letter (occasional drop) and return it to Wolten Grafe
Loot Drosco's rare Order of Thunder drop and return it to Wolten Grafe for the final reward

Locate and defeat Drosco, or his placeholder A Gelatinous Cube, roaming west from spawn
Loot A Sealed Letter from the corpse
Return the letter to Kurne Rextula

Return the tails to Clurg

Deliver the acid to Erdarf Restil in Thurgadin for a Gem of Persuasion
Trade the gem to the frost giant wolf tamer for a Giant's Gem of Persuasion
Trade the Giant's Gem back for a Giants Harness of Control
Give the harness to the Shardwurm Broodmother in Great Divide's wurm caves
Locate and kill Korf Brokenhammer at the Coldain mining caves in southeast Great Divide

nodes.label: Coldain Military Wristguard
nodes.source: Coldain Military Wristguard Quest reward (a frost giant wolf tamer, Kael Drakkal)

Locate Guard McCluskey or Guard Donlan in West Karana
Defeat them to obtain a Corrupt Guard Bracelet
Return the bracelet to Capt Linarius

Collect 2 Cutting Shells, a ground spawn in the water in Cobalt Scar
Turn both in to Ergrez Shortpaw

nodes.label: Cougarskin Boots
nodes.source: Cougarskin Boots Quest reward (Ergrez Shortpaw, Iceclad Ocean)

steps: Collect a High Quality Cougarskin from snow cougars in Eastern Wastes
Collect 2 Mammoth Meat
Deliver both to Ergrez Shortpaw

nodes.label: Cougarskin Mask
nodes.source: Cougarskin Mask Quest reward (Ergrez Shortpaw, Iceclad Ocean)

nodes.label: Cougarskin Sleeves Quest
nodes.description: Ergrez Shortpaw in Iceclad Ocean trades a Low Quality Cougarskin and Fatty Walrus Meat for arm armor.
steps: Collect a Low Quality Cougarskin from snow cougars in Eastern Wastes or Iceclad Ocean
Collect Fatty Walrus Meat from walrus or Ulthork in Eastern Wastes, Cobalt Scar, or Siren's Grotto
Hand both to Ergrez Shortpaw

nodes.label: Cougarskin Sleeves
nodes.source: Cougarskin Sleeves Quest reward (Ergrez Shortpaw, Iceclad Ocean)

nodes.label: Crude Stein Quest
nodes.description: Lork, at the Oggok warrior guild, sends players through a multi-zone fetch-and-kill chain ending in two Ambassador kills for a rare weapon or drinkware reward.
steps: Kill a fat alligator in Innothule Swamp, loot an Ogre Arm, and return it to Lork
Bring A Cracked Stein to Uglan in Neriak Foreign Quarter
Intercept and kill an orc runner in Nektulos Forest for a Sealed Letter
Return the letter to Lork in Oggok
Kill Ambassador K'Ryn in Oggok's shaman guild tunnels and loot his heart
Kill Ambassador DVinn (Lord Crushbone) in Crushbone and loot his Black Heart
Return both hearts to Lork

nodes.label: A Crude Stein
nodes.source: Crude Stein Quest rare reward (Lork, Oggok)

nodes.label: Gatorsmash Maul
nodes.source: Crude Stein Quest rare reward (Lork, Oggok)

nodes.label: Crush the Undead
nodes.description: Wolten Grafe in South Qeynos hands out a Box For Bones and trades a completed Box of Bones (6 normal Bone Chips) for a snack and faction. Doesn't work at Indifferent faction.
steps: Hail Wolten Grafe and choose the 'crush the undead' mission
Receive a Box For Bones (6-slot container)
Collect 6 normal Bone Chips and combine them in the box
Return the Box of Bones to Wolten Grafe

nodes.label: Crushbone Belts
nodes.description: Canloe Nusback in the South Kaladim Warrior's Guild trades a Crushbone Belt, looted from Orc Centurions around Faydwer, for coin, experience, and a choice of starter armor. Requires at least Dubious with Storm Guard.
steps: Hail Canloe Nusback and offer to serve Kaladim
Hand over a Crushbone Belt, randomly looted from Orc Centurions around Faydwer
Optionally turn in two Orc Legionnaire Shoulderpads for an additional reward

nodes.label: Crushbone Shoulderpads Quest
nodes.description: Canloe Nusback in the South Kaladim Warrior's Guild trades 2 Crushbone Shoulderpads, looted from Orc Legionnaires around Faydwer, for coin and experience. Repeatable turn-in.
steps: Speak with Canloe Nusback and accept the mission to destroy Crushbone orcs
Hand over 2 Crushbone Shoulderpads, randomly looted from Orc Legionnaires around Faydwer

nodes.label: Cure for Lempeck Hargrin
nodes.description: Astaed Wemor of the Paladins of the Temple of Life, in North Qeynos, sends players on a delivery chain through Rivervale (via the Honey Jum Quest) and West Karana. Requires Amiable faction or better.
steps: Complete the Honey Jum Quest in Rivervale with Kizzie Mintopp to obtain Honey Jum
Return to North Qeynos and give Honey Jum to Astaed Wemor for a Prime Healer Potion
Travel to West Karana and deliver the potion to Lempeck Hargrin for a Rusty Scythe
Return the Rusty Scythe to Astaed Wemor for the final reward

nodes.label: Shining Star of Light
nodes.source: Cure for Lempeck Hargrin reward (Astaed Wemor, North Qeynos)

nodes.label: Curscale Shield
nodes.description: Drill Master Dal, at Fortress Talishan in East Cabilis, hands new recruits a Partisan Pack to fill with four farmed items and trade back for a shield.
steps: Hail Drill Master Dal and indicate you're a new recruit
Receive a Partisan Pack
Collect Goblin Scout Beads, a sabertooth kitten canine, a giant blood sac from a giant leech, and three Bone Chips from skeletons
Combine the items in the pack to create a Full Partisan Pack
Return the completed pack to Drill Master Dal

nodes.label: Curscale Buckler
nodes.source: Curscale Shield reward (Drill Master Dal, East Cabilis)

nodes.label: Curscale Armor Quest
nodes.description: Klok Mugruk, at the Haggle Baron in East Cabilis, hands out an Empty Curskin Bag to fill with scaled curskin from Field of Bone wolf pups and cubs; repeatable for additional armor pieces.
steps: Receive an Empty Curskin Bag from Klok Mugruk
Hunt scaled wolf pups and cubs in Field of Bone and fill the bag with eight scaled curskin
Combine the skins into a Full Curskin Bag
Return the Full Curskin Bag to Klok Mugruk

nodes.label: Cursed Wafers Quest
nodes.description: Hierophant Oxyn, at the Temple of Terror in East Cabilis, trades a Full Component Mortar (small mosquito wings, a bone chip, and foraged Lake of Ill Omen mud crabs) for a snack and faction.
steps: Collect two Small Mosquito Wings and one Bone Chips
Forage one Mud Crabs in Lake of Ill Omen
Combine all four unstacked items in a Component Mortar to make a Full Component Mortar
Return the filled mortar to Hierophant Oxyn

nodes.description: Guard Valon at the West Commonlands toll booth trades a filled Bag for Cutthroat Rings, farmed from dervish cutthroats, for a Militia Armory Token. Requires the Orc Picks quest first and at least Indifferent faction with the Freeport Militia.
steps: Complete the Orc Picks quest (turn in 4 Orc Pawn Picks) first
Request to hunt dervish cutthroats from Guard Valon and receive an 8-slot Bag for Cutthroat Rings
Hunt dervish cutthroats in West Commonlands, Northern Desert of Ro, and Southern Desert of Ro for Cutthroat Insignia Rings
Combine the rings in the container and turn in the result to Guard Valon

nodes.label: Militia Armory Token
nodes.source: Cutthroat Rings reward (Guard Valon, West Commonlands)

nodes.label: Darkwood Staff Quest

steps: Hail Romar Sunto and ask about darkwood staves
Obtain a Lambent Stone from a hill giant, sand giant, or griffin
Return the Lambent Stone to Romar Sunto

nodes.label: Darkwood Staff
nodes.source: Darkwood Staff Quest reward (Romar Sunto, Temple of Solusek Ro)

nodes.label: Blackburrow Stout Quest

steps: Speak with Rueppy Kutpurse and obtain a Short Beer from Burtle Barrelbelly upstairs
Give the Short Beer to Rueppy Kutpurse
Travel to the Misty Thicket ruins, north past the tunnel on the undead hill
Find Gunrich and say 'Dark Rivers Flow East'
Receive a Case of Blackburrow Stout from Gunrich
Return to Rueppy Kutpurse and give her the case

Travel to Freeport and find Giz Dinree near the docks
Tell her "Tani sent me" to receive the mission
Enter the Seafarer's Roost at 9pm (a high-level ogre roams during the day)
Kill Lyda Nasin on the second floor behind the bar
Loot the Human Head from her corpse and return it to Tani N`Mar in Neriak

nodes.label: Cinctured Whip
nodes.source: Death of Lyda Nasin reward (Tani N`Mar, Neriak Third Gate)

steps: Good-aligned: hand Cain Darkmoore two Deathfist Slashed Belts at a time
Evil-aligned: hand Captain Hazran one Deathfist Slashed Belt at a time

Collect 4 Drolvarg Teeth from drolvargs

Deliver it to Eysa Florawhisper in The Wakening Land
Return Eysa's Token to Sentry Emil

Purchase an Innoruuk's Kiss of Death from Geoard

Return the compendium to Clurg

Return Veisha's Engagement Ring to Davorre
Kill Phaeril Nightshire and loot Phaeril Nightshire's Head
Deliver A Locked Chest to Veisha, triggering combat
Kill Veisha and return Veisha Fathomwalker's Head to Davorre

Travel to Wind Spirit's Song in South Qeynos
Obtain a Bag of Troll Guts, dropped by Zahal the Vile in Northern Karana
Hand the troll guts to Sansa Nusk for Lute Strings
Return the Lute Strings to Fabian

nodes.label: Faerie Dragon Wings

Loot both dragons' wings
Turn in both wings to the Storm Giant Foreman

nodes.label: Holgresh Mojo Stick (Air)

Speak with Faren at the East Dock

Return the Wooden Fishing Tackle to Faren

Hand it to Chef Dooga

Turn all four in to Regren for a choice of starter weapon

Collect 4 Fern Flowers and combine them into a Full Fern Flower Pouch
Return the pouch to Jondin

nodes.label: Frogskin Shield

Deliver the package to a wandering mercenary in The Wakening Land or Kael Drakkal
Return to Noble Helssen for another package

Return the dress to Zamel, Endric, or Guard Elron

nodes.label: Golden Ear Stud

Combine 10 Fire Beetle Eyes in the box to craft a Box of Beetle Eyes
Return the box to Noxhil V`Sek

Loot its Goblin Supply Pouch
Return the pouch to Narex T`Vem

nodes.label: Featherweight Pouch

Visit Bait Masterson in Qeynos Catacombs

Return the orb to Priestess Caulria
Deliver it to Lorme Tredore at the Academy of Arcane Science in West Freeport

Using the case, complete each of the six crest sub-quests (Wood Nymphs, Unicorn, Sifaye, Fauns, Drixie, Faerie Dragons -- tracked separately) and combine all six crests in it
Return the completed Case of Tunarean Crests to Shamus Aghllsews

Hand him 4 Froglok Tadpole Flesh (not stacked)

Return it to Enic Ruklin

Return the scrolls to Umvera Dekash for a Tesch Val Compilation
Take the compilation to Jheron Felkis in East Freeport for a Pawbook
Return the Pawbook to Umvera Dekash for a note

nodes.label: Gem Inlaid Gauntlets

Receive a note directing you to Warlord Hikyg, Zyzz, or Vyzer

Complete that warlord's sub-task: fill the Slave Shackle Bag with 8 Busted Froglok Slave Shackles (Hikyg), fill and combine charred bone shards in a box (Zyzz), or combine four pages in a binder (Vyzer)
Return to Drill Master Vygan for the Geozite Tool

nodes.label: Geozite Tool
nodes.source: Geozite Tool Quest reward (Drill Master Vygan, East Cabilis)

Travel to Surefall Glade and give the letter to Te'Anara

Purchase a Crows Special Brew from Crow in North Qeynos

Collect 64 Patches of Gnoll Fur from gnolls in Everfrost Peaks or Blackburrow

Hunt goblin battlemasters for Goblin Bracers

nodes.label: Burning Wood
nodes.lore: The Burning Wood (normally called Burning Woods by players, or very rarely The Burned Woods) was once an ancient, beautiful forest. Now, however, its surface has been scarred by the fiery meteors that have stricken this area in the recent centuries, leaving its surface marred and aflame.

nodes.label: Swamp of No Hope
nodes.lore: The Swamp of No Hope is a vast marsh, extending from the southeast corner of Cabilis far to the east. After the fall of the Iksar empire, the frogloks, ancient enemies of the Iksar, retook the swamp and made it their home.

nodes.label: Cobalt Scar
nodes.lore: Cobalt Scar is named after the scarring left by Veeshan as she clawed Norrath during the Dawn of Days. Large amounts of water has filled in the gouges she left behind, and now the sirens of the Siren's Grotto use its cover to lure unknowing ship crews into protruding rocks.

nodes.label: Chardok
nodes.lore: Chardok is the site of the ancient sarnak military fortress that has existed for centuries since the time of Emperor Atrebe, and is considered by the sarnaks to be their home.

nodes.label: Temple of Veeshan
nodes.lore: In the second gorge made by Veeshan the dragons built the great Temple of Veeshan where they perpetually worship their mother who deposited the first brood there eons ago. This giant temple is home to some of the mightiest dragons of Velious.

nodes.label: Western Wastes
nodes.lore: Long, long ago the great wurm Veeshan found the barren world of Norrath. She marked the lifeless void with her claw as a warning to all other deities that it now belonged to her. Her claws fell upon the continent of Velious marking the Western Wastes with two great gorges the dragons hold sacred.

Wyvern Caves

nodes.label: Icewell Keep
nodes.lore: Icewell Keep is the home of Dain, the lord of the Coldain. It is situated deeper in the mountains than Thurgadin for added protection.

nodes.label: Sleeper's Tomb
nodes.lore: Kerafyrm's Lair, also known as Sleeper's Tomb, is a dark dungeon located beneath the icy wastes of Velious, and was used by the First Brood to imprison the dragon Kerafym.

nodes.label: Plane of Growth
nodes.lore: This is the planar home of Tunare, the goddess of nature. It's entered via a portal at the top of the tower in the central part of the Wakening Land.

nodes.label: Plane of Mischief
nodes.lore: This plane is the domain of the god of mischief, Bristlebane Fizzlethrope. Full of invisible walls, one-sided doors, twisting halls, and plenty of peculiar inhabitants. The entrance is in the northern wing of the Temple of Veeshan.

nodes.source: HEHE Meat Quest reward (Carver Cagrek, Grobb)

nodes.label: Helm of the Tracker Quest
nodes.description: Tunarean Earthmelder in the Plane of Growth, requiring Ranger, Tunare deity, and Indifferent or better faction, trades a Frostgiant Overseer's Head (Frostgiant Overseer, Wakening Land), Kallis' Head (Kallis Stormcaller), and a Smashed and Bloody Protector of Zek's Head (two Protectors of Zek) for a head-slot item.
steps: Kill the Frostgiant Overseer in the Wakening Land and loot its head
Kill Kallis Stormcaller and loot her head
Kill two Protectors of Zek and loot a Smashed and a Bloody head
Return all four heads to Tunarean Earthmelder

nodes.label: Helm of the Tracker
nodes.source: Helm of the Tracker Quest reward (Tunarean Earthmelder, Plane of Growth)

nodes.label: Helms of Giant Warriors
nodes.description: Sentry Kcor in Skyshrine, accepted at Dubious or better faction, trades Giant Warrior Helmets looted from giants in Kael Drakkel (one or four at a time) for faction standing.
steps: Collect Giant Warrior Helmets from giants in Kael Drakkel
Turn them in to Sentry Kcor in Skyshrine

nodes.label: Help Hergor Get Fatter
nodes.description: Hergor in Grobb wants a Fungus Dung Pie -- made by Carver Cagrek from 4 Spore Mushrooms collected in Innothule Swamp -- for a random piece of armor and coin. Warrior only.
steps: Collect 4 Spore Mushrooms in Innothule Swamp
Trade them to Carver Cagrek for a Fungus Dung Pie
Hand the pie to Hergor

nodes.label: Herb Shop
nodes.description: Yvonne Ani in Paineel talks about her herb shop and the Seekers of Dark Truth necromancer guild -- a lore-only conversation with no turn-in or reward.
steps: Hail Yvonne Ani in Paineel and ask about her herb shop

nodes.label: Hero Bracers Quest
